question: Who is the author of the book 'Pathway to God'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pathway to God** is a book written by **Mahatma Gandhi.**__

 __
 
• It was originally published in India in the year 1971.
 
 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi is the** father of the nation India.**
 
 
• He was born on **2 October 1869.**
 
• He served as the President of the Indian national congress during its **Belgaum session** in 1924
 
• He was assassinated on **30 January 1948** by gunshot.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​ **Jawaharlal Nehru:****​**

 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru__ was the first Prime Minister of India.
 
• He served as the prime minister of India from 15th August 1947 to 1964.
 
• He is the architect of the Preamble of the Indian constitution.
 
• He was the Prime Minister of India during the Indo-China war in 1962.
 
• He served as the first chairman of the planning commission of India.
 
• He was honored with the Bharat Ratna in 1955.
 
• The name Panchayati raj was given by Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• National herald is the newspaper started by Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• He is the first prime minister to die in harness.
 
• Shantivan is the cremation ground of Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
 
 
• **Sri Aurobindo:**
 
 
• Sri Aurobindo was an Indian philosopher, yogi, guru, poet, and nationalist.
 
• Sri Aurobindo (born Aurobindo Ghose; 15 August 1872 – 5 December 1950)
 
• Sri Aurobindo believed that Darwinism merely describes a phenomenon of the evolution of matter into life, but does not explain the reason behind it, while he finds life to be already present in matter, because all of existence is a manifestation of Brahman.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel:****​**
 
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, popularly known as the Iron Man of India.
 
• He was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of India.
 
• He was instrumental in India's independence struggle, and then for the integration of over 500 princely states into the Union of India.
 
• On the birth anniversary of Sardar Patel, on October 31, 2018, PM Modi unveiled the 'Statue of Unity' in Gujarat's Narmada district.
 
• The total height of the Sardar Patel statue (182 meters) is double that of New York's Statue of Liberty
 
 

 

5d:T
